title: Answer: experienced space is centered on self-location

statements.text: The theory has no theory of physical space. Experienced space is centered on a self: the bodily self is represented as a volume, and the weak first-person perspective is projected from an extensionless point inside it. Sensory and motor systems are integrated in one body, the single embodiment constraint.

sources.quote: the weak 1PP is projected from an extensionless point, the geometrical origin of our perspectival visual model of reality
This can be called the "single embodiment-constraint".
